component.name: mcopy
component.summary: Fast, queue-aware file and folder copying

description.p: mcopy turns the file manager right-click gesture into an asynchronous copy pipeline with a live progress window and cooperative pause, resume and cancel controls.

Instead of a progress dialog you cannot influence, a copy started from Nautilus or Dolphin opens a window you can minimise, come back to, pause mid-run, or cancel — and which tells you exactly why an item was skipped rather than reporting an anonymous failure count.

ul.li: Copy and paste entries in Nautilus and Dolphin
Concurrent copying that scales with the available cores
Pause, resume and cancel without restarting the queue
A Paste entry that only appears when something has been copied
Clear, actionable reasons when an item cannot be copied
No root privileges required at any point

description.p: mcopy now sets up its own right-click entries and tells you when a new version is available.

ul.li: The setup window is gone; the menu entries register themselves
Registering the menu entries works from the AppImage
A daily update check, with verified downloads

description.p: Adds Linux support alongside Windows and macOS, native installers for every platform, and a theme-aware interface.

ul.li: Linux support with Nautilus and Dolphin integration
The logo follows the system light and dark theme
The copy progress window appears in the taskbar and can be restored
The Paste entry is hidden until something has been copied
Copy state is cleared after a successful paste
Failed copies explain why instead of reporting a bare count
